4.0.0 (2026-07-13)

⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

  • otlp-logger is no longer a transitive dependency; consumers must install the opentelemetry dependencies themselves.

Features

  • ci: test with node 26 (#256) (fe7de85)
  • remove otlp-logger dependency, use opentelemetry packages directly (#261) (030eeeb)
